remarks:
Welcome to the Gold Coast of Chautauqua Lake! Located at 320 Lakeside Drive in the heart of Bemus Point, this beautifully redesigned contemporary home offers approximately 4,414 square  finished living space which comes mostly furnished, combining upscale finishes, inviting gathering spaces, and breathtaking lake views.... 

The open-concept main living area features 4 bedrooms 3 full baths in addition to a multi use exercise or sitting room is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring vaulted and Aspen plank ceilings, expansive windows, hardwood flooring, and two gas fireplaces. The impressive kitchen showcases custom cabinetry, granite countertops, high-end appliances, and generous workspace, flowing seamlessly into the dining and living areas....

The spacious primary suite provides a private retreat with its own sitting area, while additional bedrooms and guest accommodations offer plenty of room for family and visitors. Custom cabinetry, ceramic tile, in-floor radiant heat, a finished walkout lower level, security system, generator, WiFi thermostat, and water system add comfort and convenience throughout....

Step outside to enjoy 75 feet of private Chautauqua Lake frontage with a dock, hardscaping, outdoor fireplace a custom double door storage building for outdoor furniture, summer and winter toys along with multiple flagstone patios, and professionally landscaped grounds. Whether boating, entertaining, or simply relaxing by the water, the outdoor spaces are designed to make the most of this exceptional setting....




A heated three-car detached garage has half bath, hot & cold water with ton's of upstairs storage completes this remarkable property. An exceptional opportunity to enjoy luxury, space, and waterfront living in one of Chautauqua Lake's most desirable locations.

Conveniently located just one block from the Village of Bemus Point next door to Long Point State park, near snowmobile trails with Peak n Peak and Holiday Valley ski resorts within driving distance.
